paragraphs.text: Haikou Meilan International Airport (HAK/ZJHK) serves as a key air gateway for Haikou (Meilan), CN, handling passenger arrivals, departures, and regional transit connectivity.
The airport infrastructure is managed to support scheduled airline operations, passenger check-in halls, security screening, and departure concourses.
Field runway dimensions and surface specifications: 09/27: 3600 m (11811 ft) concrete, 10/28: 3600 m (11811 ft) concrete.
Ground transportation options connecting Haikou Meilan International Airport with central Haikou (Meilan) include official airport taxi stands, rideshare services, and local municipal transit links.
Arriving passengers are encouraged to arrange transfers via designated airport transport desks or pre-booked taxi services to ensure transparent fares and reliable service into town.
Travelers departing from HAK should arrive at the airport at least two hours prior to domestic flights and three hours before international departures.
Always verify terminal departure assignments, luggage size limits, and check-in cutoff times directly with your airline prior to departure.

faqs.q: What is the airport code for Haikou Meilan International Airport?
faqs.a: The IATA code for Haikou Meilan International Airport is HAK and the ICAO code is ZJHK.

faqs.q: Which city does HAK airport serve?
faqs.a: Haikou Meilan International Airport (HAK) serves Haikou (Meilan), CN.
